book.title: MATYIW Jiysis Krays Minim Tep Matyiw Tikak

content: Jiysis Wak Nuk Ak Key Yimb Ayak
Jiysis minim kun ak aŋgiy, ñin onep kaŋgol ak mindiy; Piyta, Jemis, Jemis numam Jon ak, kuyip yakam poŋind, dum yiy akyoŋ bap amiy, key mindeyak.
Mindyakniŋ, Jiysis wak nup ak key yimb ay, jomluk ak pumb rek niŋiy, chech nuk ak ñiñakol yimb gak.
Kun gakniŋ niŋyak: bi Gor minim aŋgep nind kumrik Mosis yip Yilayja yip, ap Jiysis yip minim aŋg minderik.
Kiyk niŋiy, Piyta Jiysis nup aŋgak, “Biyomb! Chin biy mindpun ak, tep yimb mindpun. Nand yaw aŋgey ker, korip bandak band omiŋal nokom ginjun. Nip bap, Mosis nup bap, Yilayja nup bap aŋgak.”

Kun aŋgakniŋ, semb tund yimb ak apiy, kuyip maŋgiysek yiwgak. Yiwiŋg dakniŋ, minim bap semb namb kun ak nimb aŋgak, “Ñi mapin yand biy, yip tep yimb gip. Minim yerip yerip aŋgnimuŋ ak, niŋdinimimb aŋgak.”
Minim kun ak kun giy aŋgek niŋiy, Jiysis binuk gok gos kuŋay niŋiy pirikiy, apyap koŋgim yimiy, jomluk kiyk ak man akyaŋ ken ay mindeyak.
Jiysis ap kuyip diniŋiy aŋgak, “Ma piriknimimb. Tikjakim!”
Aŋgek tikjakiy niŋyak, nuk nep mindek.
Pen mak ak kuyaŋgiyiŋg, Jiysis kuyip aŋgak, “Miñiy yerer gamb niŋbim kun ak biynimb gok kuyip ma aŋgñinimimb. Kisen kumiy tikjaken mey, biynimb okok kuyip aŋgñinimimb aŋgak.”
Aŋgek nup aŋgyak, “Bi low tiysa gok yenen, Yilayja nind apeniŋgamb; kisen Kiyŋ yomb key yimb ak mankumb biy winiŋgamb apay?”
Aŋgeyak aŋgak, “Niŋind apay. Minim kun ak mindip. ‘Yilayja nind apiy kuyip aŋgrep gek, kisen Kiyŋ yomb key yimb ak winiŋgamb aŋgyak.’
Pen niŋim: Yilayja owak ak pen, apek nup ma niŋyak. Gos kiyk key niŋyak rek nup timey giyak. Bi bap Ñinuk ak nup kunep giniŋgambay aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgek, binuk gok niŋyak; Yilayja aŋgak kun ak, Jon bi ñiŋg pikñemb ak nup nep aŋgak.
Jiysis Ñi Kichekiy Ambaŋ Ayak Bap Gek Suŋ Ayak
Pen kiyk giw biyaŋ amjakiy niŋyak biynimb kuŋaynep mindeyak. Bi bap biynimb mindeyak namb kun animb ap Jiysis mindek siŋak koŋgim yimiy aŋgak,
“Biyomb! Ñi yip ak simb niŋnimin. Nup sakiy ayek mindrep ma gip. Per am mon yinimb namb okok sek, ñiŋg namb okok sek gi dam pikip.
Nup dand binak gok mindambay ak amen, nup gi mer niŋiy kirpay aŋgak.”
Aŋgek Jiysis aŋgak, “Nimb biynimb miñiy ñin biy mindpim gok, Gor nup gosimb ma niŋiy mindrep ma gipim. Minek akay niŋiy key giniŋgambim. Minim per aŋgen niŋbim ak, yergiy minim kil sek aŋgnim?”
Kun aŋgiy aŋgek dand apeyak, kichekiy nup ambaŋ ayak ak aŋgyokek; won anep suŋ ayak.
Kun gek, binuk gok Jiysis mindek ak apiy, kiyk nep mindyiŋg nup aŋgniŋiy aŋgyak, “Yergek kichekiy ambaŋ ayak kun ak, aŋgyok mer niŋiy kirpun?”

Aŋgeyak aŋgak, “Gor gek mis amniŋgamb aŋgiy, gos kilis giy ma niŋbim ak mey kun gip. Pen niŋim! Gos nimb ak mon mastet yiŋ maŋgiy sikoy mindip rek ak niŋiy, niŋwos giniŋgambim ak; tap yerip okok aŋgem, aŋgniŋgambim rek giniŋgamb. Miñmon yirik biy liŋg siŋbindoŋ amnoŋ aŋgeniŋgambim, Gor gek amniŋgamb.
[Pen kichekiy ambaŋ ayip kun ak, yikop aŋgyokep rek ma ayip. Tap keñmaŋgiy kirgiy Gor nup aŋgniŋ mindiy mey, aŋgyokpay aŋgak.”]
Jiysis Kumiy Tikjakniŋgayn Aŋgiy Tip Ak Aŋgak
Jiysis binuk gok, miñmon Galiyliy ap nan-geyak, kuyip aŋgak, “Maŋ mindip: Bi bap Ñinuk nup dand amiy, biynimb gunap kuyip ñeniŋgambay,
nup pisnep pikayey kumniŋgamb ak pen; ñin omiŋal nokom mindiy, tip ak tikjakniŋgamb aŋgak.” Kun aŋgek, binuk gok nup simb niŋiy, gos kuŋay yimb niŋyak.
Jiysis Gor Aŋgniŋep Korip Ak Takes Pikak
Pen kisen Jiysis binuk gok yip miñmon Kapaniyam ameyak, bi Gor aŋgniŋep korip takes dep gok apiy, Piyta nup aŋgyak, “Tiysa nimbik ak takes pikip sek?”

Aŋgeyak aŋgak, “Yaw! Nuk takes pikip sek aŋgak.” Piyta pen kun aŋgiy korip miŋgan amek, Jiysis nup aŋgniŋiy aŋgak, “Gos nand yerip niŋban? Gapman biyomb gok, takes maniy akay nimb dipay? Biynimb miñmon kiyk key gok nimb dipay akaŋ, biynimb par okok nimb dipay aŋgak?”
Kun aŋgek Piyta aŋgak, “Biynimb par okok nimb dipay aŋgak.” Aŋgek Jiysis aŋgak, “Bi kiyk key gok takes ma pikpay ak pen;

chin ma pikoniŋgambun; kuyip miluk yowniŋgamb rek ayip. Nand wik ak dam ñiŋg biyaŋ yokiy piys nind diniŋgamban ak, meŋg minim ak tuŋglakiy niŋniŋgamban; maniy maŋgiy won bap mindeniŋgamb. Diy dam takes chirmiŋay ak ñinimin aŋgak.” Aŋgek mey, am aŋgak rek gak.
